reason: Adds scripts/context_retention_eval.py, a standalone retention eval that drives a scratch Core only over its HTTP API (plus optional read-only SQLite probes), its unit tests, and a 'Measuring retention' section in docs/CHAT_CONTEXT_LIFECYCLE.md. No Core, UI, native or provider code changes. The selected file covers the script's pure parts: deterministic scenario generation, exact-match scoring and answer-line parsing, tool re-read counting, cache-aware pricing, metrics, aggregation and the Markdown report.
exclusions: No src/, ui/ or native code changes, so Core Python suites, frontend, native and Playwright tests are excluded (the script imports nothing from Core). The script's HTTP driving is exercised against real scratch Cores served from origin/main (baseline run recorded in the PR), not in CI, because it needs a provider key and a real model. No full-suite, browser, LAN or device gate is claimed.
